summary: Challenge to High Court order directing further investigation after trial concluded; Section 311 Cr.P.C. application rejected at trial stage due to delay (6+ years); High Court previously dismissed revision against same rejection; appellant argued prejudice and belatedness; scope of 'additional evidence' under Section 311: must be essential for just decision not causing prejudice; court held further investigation unjustified post-trial when facts known to party earlier; final arguments completed before impugned order.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court order for further investigation set aside; trial court's dismissal of Section 311 application upheld.
